Manuscript section "Intervention efficacy persists among the most entrenched believers" and Appendix D: condition x baseline
interactions, GAMs, a shift-function CDF and baseline-adjusted quantile regression, the type-of-change summary, die-hard vs.
non-die-hard models, ceiling-censoring robustness (Tobit and ceiling-escape models) and random-forest variable importance (a
robustness comparison; the main-text variable-importance figure comes from `09_heterogeneity_forests.Rmd`). Produces
`figures/fig-baseline-conviction.png`, `figures/supplement/fig-belief-change.png`, `results/models_belief_level.rds`
and `results/models_ceiling.rds`.

```{r regression helper fns, include=FALSE}

#helper: p-value stars ----
add_stars <- function(p_values) {
  ifelse(p_values < 0.001, "***",
         ifelse(p_values < 0.01, "**",
                ifelse(p_values < 0.05, "*", "")))
}

#run robust OLS for one DV pair ----
analyze_regression <- function(dvs_post, dvs_pre, data, study, interaction = FALSE) {

  # Build formula
  formula_base <- paste(dvs_post, "~", dvs_pre, "+ ConditionFeedback")

  if (interaction) {
    formula_base <- paste(formula_base, "* ConditionChat")
  }

  if (study == 1) {
    formula_base <- paste(formula_base, "+ ConditionChat")
  }

  formula <- as.formula(formula_base)

  # Fit model
  model <- lm(formula, data = data)

  # Robust (HC1) variance-cov matrix
  V <- vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")

  # Robust coefficient test (SE, t, p all robust-consistent)
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = V)

  # Return tidy dataframe
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    term      = rownames(ct),
    estimate  = unname(ct[, 1]),
    std.error = unname(ct[, 2]),
    statistic = unname(ct[, 3]),
    p.value   = unname(ct[, 4]),
    outcome   = dvs_post
  )

  out
}

#combine / format for kable ----
combine_regression_results <- function(regression_results, study) {
  bind_rows(regression_results) %>%
    mutate(Study = study) %>%
    rename(
      Term = term,
      Estimate = estimate,
      `Robust SE` = std.error,
      `Robust t` = statistic,
      `Adj p` = p.value,
      DV = outcome
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Significance = add_stars(`Adj p`),
      `Estimate (SE)` = paste0(
        format(round(Estimate, 2), nsmall = 2), Significance,
        " (", format(round(`Robust SE`, 2), nsmall = 2), ")"
      ),
      `Adj p` = signif(`Adj p`, 3)
    ) %>%
    select(Study, DV, Term, `Estimate (SE)`, `Adj p`)
}

#1. main models

# ---- shared helpers for tab_model versions of these tables ----
# builds the same formula analyze_regression() used, but returns it instead of a fitted model,
# so we can fit + keep the model object itself for tab_model()
build_formula_legacy <- function(dv, dv_pre, study, interaction = FALSE) {
  formula_base <- paste(dv, "~", dv_pre, "+ ConditionFeedback")
  if (interaction) formula_base <- paste(formula_base, "* ConditionChat")
  if (study == 1) formula_base <- paste(formula_base, "+ ConditionChat")
  as.formula(formula_base)
}

# fits one lm() per dv and returns a named list of model objects (name = raw dv variable name),
# ready to pass straight into tab_model(). Robust HC1 SEs are applied at display time via
# tab_model(vcov.fun = "vcovHC", vcov.type = "HC1"), not baked into the model object itself.
fit_model_list <- function(dvs, dvs_pre, data, study, interaction = FALSE) {
  models <- purrr::map2(dvs, dvs_pre, ~ lm(build_formula_legacy(.x, .y, study, interaction), data = data))
  names(models) <- dvs
  models
}
```

```{r cohens d function, include=FALSE}

calculate_dppc2 <- function(data, pre_col, post_col, group_col) {
  # Summarize data by group
  summary_stats <- data %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    summarise(
      pre_mean = mean({{ pre_col }}, na.rm = TRUE),
      pre_sd = sd({{ pre_col }}, na.rm = TRUE),
      post_mean = mean({{ post_col }}, na.rm = TRUE),
      post_sd = sd({{ post_col }}, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Extract treatment and control stats
  T.n <- summary_stats[2, ]$n
  C.n <- summary_stats[1, ]$n
  
  T.sd_pre <- summary_stats[2, ]$pre_sd
  C.sd_pre <- summary_stats[1, ]$pre_sd
  
  T.m_post <- summary_stats[2, ]$post_mean
  C.m_post <- summary_stats[1, ]$post_mean
  
  T.m_pre <- summary_stats[2, ]$pre_mean
  C.m_pre <- summary_stats[1, ]$pre_mean
  
  # Calculate pooled standard deviation
  sd.pooled <- sqrt(((T.n - 1) * T.sd_pre^2 + (C.n - 1) * C.sd_pre^2) / (T.n + C.n - 2))
  
  # Calculate the effect size using Cohen's method
  yi <- metafor:::.cmicalc(T.n + C.n - 2) * ((T.m_post - T.m_pre) - (C.m_post - C.m_pre)) / sd.pooled
  
  # Return a list containing all computed values
  list(
    treatment_n = T.n,
    control_n = C.n,
    treatment_pre_sd = round(T.sd_pre, 2),
    control_pre_sd = round(C.sd_pre, 2),
    treatment_post_mean = round(T.m_post, 2),
    control_post_mean = round(C.m_post, 2),
    treatment_pre_mean = round(T.m_pre, 2),
    control_pre_mean = round(C.m_pre, 2),
    pooled_sd = round(sd.pooled, 2),
    effect_size = round(yi, 2)
  )
} 
```

# 1. Change relative to baseline conviction: GAMs & quantile regression

### 1.1. Interaction with baseline belief levels
```{r 2a. belief level interaction fn, warning=FALSE}

# Robust (HC1) inference + stars; displays "Estimate (SE)" column.

# ---- baseline interaction regression (robust p-values) ----
analyze_int <- function(dvs_post, dvs_pre, data, study) {

  # dv_post ~ ConditionFeedback * baseline + (ConditionChat if Study 1)
  formula_base <- paste(dvs_post, "~ ConditionFeedback *", dvs_pre)
  if (study == 1) formula_base <- paste(formula_base, "+ ConditionChat")
  formula <- as.formula(formula_base)

  model <- lm(formula, data = data)

  V  <- sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = V)

  tibble::tibble(
    term      = rownames(ct),
    estimate  = unname(ct[, 1]),
    std.error = unname(ct[, 2]),
    statistic = unname(ct[, 3]),
    p.value   = unname(ct[, 4]),
    outcome   = dvs_post
  )
}

# ---- run interaction models ----
reg_s1_int <- purrr::map2(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, ~ analyze_int(.x, .y, df_consp,   study = 1))
reg_s2_int <- purrr::map2(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, ~ analyze_int(.x, .y, df_consp_2, study = 2))

# ---- combine + label (uses combine_regression_results(), which keeps `Estimate (SE)` + stars) ----
regression_int <- combine_regression_results(reg_s1_int, 1) %>%
  bind_rows(combine_regression_results(reg_s2_int, 2)) %>%
  mutate(DV = dplyr::recode(DV, !!!new_labels))

# ---- display: cleanresults stargazer version ----
```

#### Figure: Change by baseline conviction (`fig-baseline-conviction`)

```{r 2b. final gam graphs, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

df_both2 <- df_both %>% filter(!(is.na(ConditionFeedback)))
control_label <- "Control"

# predicted change at the die-hard ceiling (baseline = 100), per condition, from each panel's own GAM -- quantifies the regression-to-the-mean 
gam_ceiling_delta <- function(data, x_var, y_var) {
  fits <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_var]]), !is.na(.data[[y_var]])) %>%
    group_by(ConditionFeedback) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      fit <- mgcv::gam(reformulate(paste0("s(", x_var, ", bs = \"cs\")"), response = y_var), data = .x)
      gam_pred <- predict(fit, newdata = setNames(data.frame(100), x_var), se.fit = TRUE)
      tibble(pred = as.numeric(gam_pred$fit), se = as.numeric(gam_pred$se.fit))
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  ctl <- fits %>% filter(ConditionFeedback == control_label)
  fits %>%
    filter(ConditionFeedback != control_label) %>%
    mutate(delta = ctl$pred - pred, delta_se = sqrt(se^2 + ctl$se^2)) %>%
    slice_max(delta, n = 1) %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("At the die-hard ceiling:\n%s shows %.1f pp\nmore reduction than Control",
                            ConditionFeedback, delta, delta_se))
}

ann_gama <- gam_ceiling_delta(df_both2, "ER0Norm_Pre", "ER0_Diff")
ann_gamb <- gam_ceiling_delta(df_both2, "Sureness_Pre_1", "Sureness_Diff")

# shared style for the small in-panel stat callouts, kept consistent across all three panels
ann_style <- list(size = 2.8, color = "gray25", fontface = "plain")

  #geom_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0.3, alpha = 0.1, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", alpha = .15, linewidth = 0.9) +

  #geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50") +
  geom_text(data = ann_gama, aes(label = label), x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.4,
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = ann_style$size, color = ann_style$color, fontface = ann_style$fontface) +

       subtitle = "2020 Denialism") +

#fig c - shift function: quantile-of-change difference vs. control, per outcome
# (replaces the raw CDF - shift function comparing quantiles of the condition's distribution directly against control's, so a departure from 0 reflects a real difference, not just shape.)
df_cdf_long <- df_both %>%
  filter(!is.na(ConditionFeedback)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ER0_Diff, Sureness_Diff), names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Outcome = dplyr::recode(Outcome,
                                  ER0_Diff = "2020 Denialism",
                                  Sureness_Diff = "Claim Certainty"),
         ConditionFeedback = as.character(ConditionFeedback)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))

shift_qs <- seq(.1, .9, .1)
shift_R <- 2000

shift_function <- function(ctrl, trt, qs, R) {
  q_ctrl <- quantile(ctrl, probs = qs, type = 6)
  q_trt  <- quantile(trt, probs = qs, type = 6)
  diff <- q_trt - q_ctrl
  boot <- replicate(R, {
    cb <- sample(ctrl, length(ctrl), replace = TRUE)
    tb <- sample(trt, length(trt), replace = TRUE)
    quantile(tb, probs = qs, type = 6) - quantile(cb, probs = qs, type = 6)
  })
  tibble(q = qs, diff = diff,
         ci_lo = apply(boot, 1, quantile, 0.025),
         ci_hi = apply(boot, 1, quantile, 0.975))
}

shift_results <- df_cdf_long %>%
  group_by(Outcome) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    ctrl_vals <- .x$Value[.x$ConditionFeedback == control_label]
    active_lvls <- setdiff(unique(.x$ConditionFeedback), control_label)
    purrr::map_dfr(active_lvls, function(lvl) {
      shift_function(ctrl_vals, .x$Value[.x$ConditionFeedback == lvl], shift_qs, shift_R) %>%
        mutate(ConditionFeedback = lvl)
    })
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

fig.cdf <- ggplot(shift_results, aes(x = q, y = diff, color = ConditionFeedback, fill = ConditionFeedback)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~Outcome) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = shift_qs, labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors, name = "Condition") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, name = "Condition") +
  labs(
    x = "Quantile of the change-score distribution",
    y = "Condition - Control difference"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

(fig.gama | fig.gamb) 


fig2 <- (fig.gama | fig.gamb) / fig.cdf +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_suffix = ")") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```

```{r fig d1 - quantile regression, warning=FALSE}
# supplement Fig D1: baseline-adjusted quantile regression - condition effect vs. control
# at each quantile of the change score, controlling for baseline (nets out both regression-
# to-the-mean AND distribution shape in one model; see fig.cdf above for the unadjusted version)
pacman::p_load(quantreg)

df_both_qr <- df_both2
df_both_qr$ConditionFeedback <- relevel(factor(df_both_qr$ConditionFeedback), ref = control_label)

qr_taus <- seq(.1, .9, .1)

run_qr <- function(data, x_var, y_var, outcome_label) {
  data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[x_var]]), !is.na(.data[[y_var]]))
  form <- reformulate(c(x_var, "ConditionFeedback"), response = y_var)
  fit <- quantreg::rq(form, tau = qr_taus, data = data)
  s <- summary(fit, se = "boot", R = 500)
  purrr::map2_dfr(s, qr_taus, function(tau_summary, tau_val) {
    co <- tau_summary$coefficients
    rows <- grep("^ConditionFeedback", rownames(co))
    tibble(
      ConditionFeedback = sub("^ConditionFeedback", "", rownames(co)[rows]),
      tau = tau_val,
      estimate = co[rows, "Value"],
      se = co[rows, "Std. Error"]
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(ci_lo = estimate - 1.96 * se, ci_hi = estimate + 1.96 * se, Outcome = outcome_label)
}

qr_results <- bind_rows(
  run_qr(df_both_qr, "ER0Norm_Pre", "ER0_Diff", "2020 Denialism"),
  run_qr(df_both_qr, "Sureness_Pre_1", "Sureness_Diff", "Claim Certainty")
)

fig.d1 <- ggplot(qr_results, aes(x = tau, y = estimate, color = ConditionFeedback, fill = ConditionFeedback)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
```

### 1.4. Die-hards vs. non-die-hards

```{r percent-change helpers, include=FALSE}
# Copied from 05_results_effects.Rmd ("1. % change fn") so this script is self-contained: the die-hard %-change
# models below call these and previously failed with "could not find function" unless 02 had been run first.
analyze_regperc <- function(dvs_post, data, study) {
  data_clean <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[dvs_post]]) & is.finite(.data[[dvs_post]]))
  formula <- if (study == 1) {
    as.formula(paste(dvs_post, "~ ConditionFeedback + ConditionChat"))
  } else {
    as.formula(paste(dvs_post, "~ ConditionFeedback"))
  }
  model <- lm(formula, data = data_clean)
  V  <- sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = V)
  tibble::tibble(term = rownames(ct), estimate = unname(ct[, 1]), std.error = unname(ct[, 2]),
                 statistic = unname(ct[, 3]), p.value = unname(ct[, 4]), outcome = dvs_post)
}

combine_regperc_results <- function(regression_results, study) {
  bind_rows(regression_results) %>%
    mutate(Study = study) %>%
    rename(Term = term, Estimate = estimate, `Robust SE` = std.error, `Robust t` = statistic, `Adj p` = p.value, DV = outcome) %>%
    mutate(Significance = add_stars(`Adj p`),
           `Estimate (SE)` = paste0(format(round(Estimate * 100, 2), nsmall = 2), "%", Significance,
                                    " (", format(round(`Robust SE` * 100, 2), nsmall = 2), "%)"),
           `Adj p` = signif(`Adj p`, 3)) %>%
    select(Study, DV, Term, `Estimate (SE)`, `Adj p`)
}
```

```{r save models for supplement, include=FALSE}
# per-outcome lm fits with the same specification as analyze_regression(). Formulas live in the global environment so
# the saved models do not drag their calling environment (and a copy of the data) along.
fit_lm_list <- function(dvs, pres, data, study) {
  fits <- purrr::map2(dvs, pres, ~ lm(as.formula(paste(.x, "~", .y, "+ ConditionFeedback", if (study == 1) "+ ConditionChat"), env = globalenv()), data = data))
  names(fits) <- dvs

  names(fits) <- dvs
  fits
}

       s = tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(s$s.table), "term"),
       n = s$n, r2 = s$r.sq)
}
```

### 1.5. Ceiling-censoring robustness check (Tobit + ceiling-escape)

<!-- The chunk "save ceiling models for supplement" below feeds the supplement's Tobit and ceiling-escape tables.
Two checks, motivated by the view that a self-reported 100 is a scale ceiling rather than a literally dogmatic prior:
(1) Tobit models on the full analytic samples that treat 0 and 100 as censoring points rather than hard bounds
(a Tobit effect that matches OLS in sign but is larger in magnitude would be consistent with OLS being attenuated
by ceiling censoring); (2) among die-hards, whether they leave the ceiling at all, tested with a logistic model in
the same style as the AnyChange ~ ConditionFeedback check above (3.3). -->

#### Tobit: is OLS attenuated by ceiling censoring?

```{r 2e. tobit vs ols, warning=FALSE}

# left/right = 0/100: both headline DVs (2020 Denialism, Claim Certainty) are 0-100 scales with
# mass at the ceiling among die-hards. Uses the *same* formula as the main OLS models
# (build_formula(), defined earlier - see "1. main models") so the treatment coefficient is
# directly comparable to models_s1/models_s2 above; only the estimator changes (OLS vs. censored
# MLE via survival::survreg under the hood).

tobit_dvs     <- c("ER0Norm_Post", "Sureness_Post_1")
tobit_dvs_pre <- c("ER0Norm_Pre_center", "Sureness_Pre_center")

# AER::tobit() fails on newer survival versions (its match.call()/eval() re-dispatch to survreg()), so
# survival::survreg() is called directly on an interval-censored response built by make_surv() below.
# Left/right censoring at 0/100 is Surv(low, high, type = "interval2"): interior values are exact
# (low == high == value), a value at or above 100 is right-censored (low = 100, high = NA), and a value
# at or below 0 is left-censored (low = NA, high = 0). This is the model AER::tobit() would fit.

make_surv <- function(y, left = 0, right = 100) {
  # ER0Norm_Post / Sureness_Post_1 carry the `labelled` class (Hmisc/labelled variable labels),
  # which dplyr::case_when() refuses to combine with a plain double (NA_real_) - strip it to the
  # underlying numeric values first. as.numeric() is safe here (unlike for a factor/categorical
  # labelled column): these are labelled *doubles*, so it returns the actual scores, not codes.
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  low  <- dplyr::case_when(y <= left ~ NA_real_, y >= right ~ right, TRUE ~ y)
  high <- dplyr::case_when(y <= left ~ left,     y >= right ~ NA_real_, TRUE ~ y)
  survival::Surv(low, high, type = "interval2")
}

build_formula_tobit <- function(dv, dv_pre, study) {
  formula_base <- paste0("make_surv(", dv, ", left = 0, right = 100) ~ ", dv_pre, " + ConditionFeedback")
  if (study == 1) formula_base <- paste(formula_base, "+ ConditionChat")
  as.formula(formula_base)
}

fit_tobit_list <- function(dvs, dvs_pre, dat, study) {
  models <- purrr::map2(dvs, dvs_pre, function(dv, dv_pre) {
    survival::survreg(build_formula_tobit(dv, dv_pre, study), data = dat, dist = "gaussian")
  })
  names(models) <- dvs
  models
}

tobit_s1 <- fit_tobit_list(tobit_dvs, tobit_dvs_pre, df_consp,   study = 1)
tobit_s2 <- fit_tobit_list(tobit_dvs, tobit_dvs_pre, df_consp_2, study = 2)

# Manual OLS-vs-Tobit comparison via broom::tidy(); tab_model() below gives a formatted version of the
# Tobit models alone (the vcov.fun="vcovHC" override used elsewhere is only defined for lm).
compare_ols_tobit <- function(dv, ols_models, tobit_models, study) {
  ols_tidy <- broom::tidy(ols_models[[dv]]) %>% mutate(Model = "OLS")
  tobit_tidy <- broom::tidy(tobit_models[[dv]]) %>%
    filter(term != "Log(scale)") %>%
    mutate(Model = "Tobit (0/100 censored)")
  bind_rows(ols_tidy, tobit_tidy) %>%
    mutate(Study = study, DV = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!new_labels)) %>%
    select(Study, DV, Model, term, estimate, std.error, p.value)
}

tobit_compare <- bind_rows(
  purrr::map_dfr(tobit_dvs, compare_ols_tobit, ols_models = models_s1, tobit_models = tobit_s1, study = 1),
  purrr::map_dfr(tobit_dvs, compare_ols_tobit, ols_models = models_s2, tobit_models = tobit_s2, study = 2)
) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(term, "Intercept")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, p.value), ~ round(.x, 3)))

tobit_compare %>%
  kable(caption = "OLS vs. Tobit (0/100-Censored) Treatment Coefficients", align = "l") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times New Roman") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "responsive"), font_size = 12, fixed_thead = TRUE) %>%
  collapse_rows(1:3, row_group_label_position = "stack", valign = "top")

# Formatted tab_model() version, Tobit models only - intentionally omits vcov.fun/vcov.type
# (HC1/vcovHC is not defined for survreg objects); the OLS side already has HC1 SEs applied in
# the main results tables above (see "1. main models").
tab_model(tobit_s1,
          col.order = c("est","se","p"),
          dv.labels = new_labels[tobit_dvs],
          title = "Study 1: Tobit (0/100-Censored) Models")

tab_model(tobit_s2,
          col.order = c("est","se","p"),
          dv.labels = new_labels[tobit_dvs],
          title = "Study 2: Tobit (0/100-Censored) Models")

```

#### Ceiling-escape: do die-hards move at all?

```{r 2f. ceiling escape, warning=FALSE}

# Restricted to participants who started at the literal ceiling (CCDieHard/Den2020DieHard == 1,
# defined earlier as Sureness_Pre_1 == 100 / ER0Norm_Pre == 100). Because they start at the max,
# their Diff score can only be <= 0, so "escaped the ceiling" is equivalent to "any negative
# movement," which is equivalent to NOT already being flagged by the existing *DieHardNoChange
# variables - reusing that existing logic/variable rather than redefining it a second way.

df_consp_escape   <- df_consp   %>% mutate(CC_Escaped  = if_else(CCDieHard == 1, 1 - CCDieHardNoChange, NA_real_),
                                            Den_Escaped = if_else(Den2020DieHard == 1, 1 - Den2020DieHardNoChange, NA_real_))
df_consp_2_escape <- df_consp_2 %>% mutate(CC_Escaped  = if_else(CCDieHard == 1, 1 - CCDieHardNoChange, NA_real_),
                                            Den_Escaped = if_else(Den2020DieHard == 1, 1 - Den2020DieHardNoChange, NA_real_))

m.escape.cc.s1  <- glm(CC_Escaped  ~ ConditionFeedback, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = df_consp_escape   %>% filter(CCDieHard == 1))
m.escape.cc.s2  <- glm(CC_Escaped  ~ ConditionFeedback, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = df_consp_2_escape %>% filter(CCDieHard == 1))
m.escape.den.s1 <- glm(Den_Escaped ~ ConditionFeedback, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = df_consp_escape   %>% filter(Den2020DieHard == 1))
m.escape.den.s2 <- glm(Den_Escaped ~ ConditionFeedback, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = df_consp_2_escape %>% filter(Den2020DieHard == 1))

# raw escape rates by condition, for interpretability alongside the model output
df_consp_escape   %>% filter(CCDieHard == 1)      %>% group_by(ConditionFeedback) %>% summarise(n = n(), pct_escaped = mean(CC_Escaped,  na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
df_consp_2_escape %>% filter(CCDieHard == 1)      %>% group_by(ConditionFeedback) %>% summarise(n = n(), pct_escaped = mean(CC_Escaped,  na.rm = TRUE) * 100)

df_consp_2_escape %>% filter(Den2020DieHard == 1) %>% group_by(ConditionFeedback) %>% summarise(n = n(), pct_escaped = mean(Den_Escaped, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)

res_escape_cc_s1 <- clean_regress(df_consp_escape %>% filter(CCDieHard == 1), dvs = "CC_Escaped", type = "logistic", predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback, dv_labels = c(CC_Escaped = "Study 1 CC Escaped"))
res_escape_cc_s2 <- clean_regress(df_consp_2_escape %>% filter(CCDieHard == 1), dvs = "CC_Escaped", type = "logistic", predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback, dv_labels = c(CC_Escaped = "Study 2 CC Escaped"))
```

```{r save ceiling models for supplement, include=FALSE}
# Everything 5-disseminate/supplement.qmd needs for the ceiling-robustness tables (Tobit vs. OLS; ceiling escape among
# die-hards). Saved as tidy results rather than model objects: survreg/glm objects carry their calling environment.
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

# OLS (HC1) and Tobit (0/100-censored) side by side for every non-intercept term. Tobit SEs are given two ways: the
# model-based SEs used in the comparison table above and Huber sandwich SEs (survreg(robust = TRUE)), which are the
# like-for-like counterpart of the HC1 SEs reported for OLS everywhere else.
tobit_rows <- function(dv, dv_pre, dat, study, ols_models) {
  f     <- build_formula_tobit(dv, dv_pre, study)
  naive <- summary(survival::survreg(f, data = dat, dist = "gaussian"))$table
  rob   <- summary(survival::survreg(f, data = dat, dist = "gaussian", robust = TRUE))$table
  ols   <- modelsummary::get_estimates(ols_models[[dv]], vcov = "HC1")
  y     <- as.numeric(dat[[dv]])
  n_ols <- nobs(ols_models[[dv]])   # computed outside tibble(): inside it, `dv` would be the new column
  keep  <- setdiff(rownames(naive), c("(Intercept)", "Log(scale)"))
  keep  <- keep[!is.na(naive[keep, "Value"])]   # factor levels absent from this study's data (aliased, NA coefficient)
  tibble::tibble(
    study = study, dv = dv, term = keep,
    ols_b = ols$estimate[match(keep, ols$term)], ols_se = ols$std.error[match(keep, ols$term)], ols_p = ols$p.value[match(keep, ols$term)],
    tobit_b = naive[keep, "Value"],
    tobit_se_model = naive[keep, "Std. Error"], tobit_p_model = naive[keep, "p"],
    tobit_se_robust = rob[keep, "Std. Err"],    tobit_p_robust = rob[keep, "p"],
    n = n_ols, n_at_0 = sum(y <= 0, na.rm = TRUE), n_at_100 = sum(y >= 100, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
tobit_res <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  purrr::map2_dfr(tobit_dvs, tobit_dvs_pre, ~ tobit_rows(.x, .y, df_consp,   1, models_s1)),
  purrr::map2_dfr(tobit_dvs, tobit_dvs_pre, ~ tobit_rows(.x, .y, df_consp_2, 2, models_s2))
)

# ceiling escape: raw rates by condition, the logit coefficients, and the omnibus likelihood-ratio test of condition
escape_res <- function(model, dat, diehard_flag, escaped) {
  d <- dat %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[diehard_flag]] == 1)
  list(coef  = broom::tidy(model) %>% dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value),
       rates = d %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(ConditionFeedback)) %>% dplyr::group_by(ConditionFeedback) %>%
         dplyr::summarise(n = sum(!is.na(.data[[escaped]])), pct_escaped = mean(.data[[escaped]], na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>% dplyr::filter(n > 0) %>% dplyr::mutate(ConditionFeedback = as.character(ConditionFeedback)),
       lrt_p = drop1(model, test = "LRT")[["Pr(>Chi)"]][2], n = nobs(model))
}
out_ceiling <- list(
  tobit  = tobit_res,
  escape = list(cc_s1  = escape_res(m.escape.cc.s1,  df_consp_escape,   "CCDieHard",      "CC_Escaped"),
                cc_s2  = escape_res(m.escape.cc.s2,  df_consp_2_escape, "CCDieHard",      "CC_Escaped"),
                den_s1 = escape_res(m.escape.den.s1, df_consp_escape,   "Den2020DieHard", "Den_Escaped"),
                den_s2 = escape_res(m.escape.den.s2, df_consp_2_escape, "Den2020DieHard", "Den_Escaped")),
  labels = list(dv = new_labels)
)
saveRDS(out_ceiling, "results/models_ceiling.rds")
saveRDS(out_ceiling, "results/models_03_ceiling.rds")
```

```{r 4. random forest, warning=FALSE}
)

clean_rf_var <- function(x, label_map) {
  mapped <- x %in% names(label_map)
  x[mapped] <- label_map[x[mapped]]
  x[!mapped] <- gsub("_", " ", x[!mapped])
  x[!mapped] <- gsub("\\.", " ", x[!mapped])
  x
}
```
